values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Ramp access to Grass Lake Flooding and carry-in access to the Betsie River at the campground.

note: Michigan DNR state forest campground on Grass Lake Flooding by the Betsie River in the Pere Marquette State Forest (Benzie County), managed by Colfax Township. Accessed by a maintained dirt road passable by a normal vehicle (not 4WD); a reviewer fit a 30-ft trailer. --Claude
